package.name: watcher_moves_demo
package.description: A carrier, an ally and a watcher. The carrier must let the ally know which bay its load goes to and must not let the watcher know. The watcher stands on one of two sides; every way of telling the ally is on a side. The epistemic policy reads the duty board first and tells on the side the watcher is not; no plan that does not look can work in all four worlds, and the classical carrier never looks.
